Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Walkthrough
- Added an optional, 17-step walkthrough covering Review, Replay, Widgets, Analyzer, Options, Data, and Updates.
- Opens each section, highlights relevant controls, and explains how to use and understand the information.
- Automatically selects the first saved pull with deaths, skipping Now, and opens a death's lead-up and summary.
- Selects saved data when entering Replay, Widgets, and Analyzer. Users can still change selections afterward.
- Includes name-redacted tutorial data when suitable recorded data is unavailable. Samples remain separate from saved history.
- Reopen it anytime using Walkthrough in the header.

Capture Improvements
- DPS Meter encounters can now start from opening damage without waiting for your character's combat flag.
- Regular content now requires a verified game death notification before recording a death. This should prevent random death detections when dungeon mob packs end or player state disappears.
- Preserved existing death-detection behavior in Extreme, Savage, Ultimate, and Criterion Savage content.

Help Updates
- Added a DPS Meter screenshot to the website and Help Center.
- Clarified name redaction and the separate appearance controls for each widget.
